run_model_chat_crowdsourcing_task: run the model chat crowdsourcing task using hydra config and the run_task entry point
configure_scriptconfig_for_mturk: configure the ScriptConfig dataclass to set monitoring log rate and task directory for MTurk runs
override_hydra_config_defaults: override the hydra config defaults to switch from the example conf to a custom crowdsourcing config
set_task_directory_path: set the TASK_DIRECTORY constant to point to the model chat task directory for crowdsourcing
register_scriptconfig_with_hydra: register the ScriptConfig module with hydra using register_script_config for crowdsourcing task launches
